# SHADDAI - full tool reference

> 971 tools with their input schemas. The short index is at /llms.txt.

Generated 2026-10-21.

## fetch_price

Live crypto price from CoinGecko. Returns USD price, 24h change %, market cap, volume.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "symbol": "string — coin id e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, dogecoin"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_fear_greed

Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0=Extreme Fear, 100=Extreme Greed). Also returns 7-day history.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_trending

Top 7 trending crypto coins on CoinGecko right now.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_ohlcv

Price history (OHLCV candles) for a coin over last N days from CoinGecko.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "symbol": "string — coin id e.g. bitcoin",
    "days": "number — 1, 7, 14, 30, 90"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_global_market

Global crypto market overview: total market cap, BTC dominance, 24h volume, active coins.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

```json
    "symbol": "string — coin id e.g. solana"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": "string — token name, symbol, or contract address"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_defi_tvl

DeFi Total Value Locked data from DeFiLlama. Top protocols by TVL.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "limit": "number — how many protocols to return (default 10)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_sol_balance

Get SOL balance of any Solana wallet address. Uses mainnet-beta public RPC.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "address": "string — Solana wallet address (base58)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_eth_balance

Get ETH balance of any Ethereum wallet. Uses Cloudflare public RPC (no key needed).

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "address": "string — Ethereum address (0x...)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_exchange_rates

Live fiat currency exchange rates (USD base). Free, no key required.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "currencies": "string — comma-separated currency codes e.g. EUR,GBP,JPY,CAD"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## search_web

Web search — tries Google News RSS (great for recent news) then DuckDuckGo Instant Answer. Returns titles, snippets, URLs.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": "string — search query"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## wikipedia_search

Search Wikipedia. Reliable for facts, people, concepts, technology. Returns article summary.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": "string — topic to look up on Wikipedia"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## fetch_url

Fetch full text from any URL. Strips HTML, returns clean readable text (first 3000 chars).

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": "string — full https:// URL"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_hackernews

Top Hacker News stories right now. Returns titles, URLs, scores, comment counts.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "limit": "number — stories to return (default 10, max 20)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_rss_feed

Fetch and parse any RSS/Atom feed URL. Returns latest items with title, link, summary.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": "string — RSS feed URL",
    "limit": "number — items to return (default 8)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_github_trending

Recently trending GitHub repos (sorted by stars, pushed in last 7 days). Uses public GitHub API.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "language": "string — language filter e.g. javascript (optional)",
    "topic": "string — topic e.g. llm, agents (optional)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_github_repo

GitHub repository details: stars, forks, issues, language, recent activity. No auth needed.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "repo": "string — owner/repo e.g. microsoft/vscode"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## search_npm

Search npm registry for packages. Returns name, version, description, weekly downloads.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": "string — package name or keyword",
    "limit": "number — results (default 5)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_weather

Current weather for any city. Returns temp, conditions, humidity, wind.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "city": "string — city name e.g. \"New York\", \"London\", \"Tokyo\""
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## run_js

Execute JavaScript in a sandboxed Node.js vm. Returns console output and result value.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "code": "string — JavaScript code to execute"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## run_python

Execute Python code via system Python. Returns stdout. Requires ALLOW_PYTHON_EXEC=true env var; disabled by default for security.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "code": "string — Python code to run"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## calculate

Safely evaluate math expressions. Supports +,-,*,/,**,sqrt,log,sin,cos,PI,E,floor,ceil.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "expression": "string — math expression e.g. \"sqrt(144) * 2 + log(100)\""
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## check_security

PIKADON security audit: SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets, eval, path traversal, CORS, CSRF, insecure deps.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "code": "string — code snippet or file content to audit"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## write_file

Write content to a file in generated-output/. Safe filename auto-generated. Returns path.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "filename": "string — desired filename with extension",
    "content": "string — file content"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## read_file

Read a file from generated-output/ by filename. Returns content up to 5000 chars.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "filename": "string — filename only (no path)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## list_files

List all files in generated-output/ with size and modification time.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## save_to_inbox

Save agent output to SHADDAI inbox. User sees it in dashboard inbox tab.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subject": "string",
    "content": "string",
    "agent": "string"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## save_memory

Persist a key-value pair to agent memory. Survives across tasks. Use to remember important facts.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "key": "string — memory key",
    "value": "string — value to store",
    "agent": "string — which agent owns this"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## mint_collectible

Mint a new collectible NFT-style receipt. Persists to backend/data/collectibles.json with HMAC signature.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": "string — collectible name",
    "rarity": "string — common|rare|epic|legendary",
    "owner": "string — owner agent or user"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## list_collectible

List a collectible on the marketplace at a credit price.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": "number — collectible id",
    "priceCredits": "number — listing price"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

```json
{

}
```

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## bid_on_job

Place a bid on an open marketplace job. Appends to job.bids array.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "jobId": "string — job id",
    "agent": "string — bidding agent",
    "bidCredits": "number — bid amount",
    "eta": "string — estimated delivery"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## complete_job

Mark a marketplace job as completed, store deliverable, and credit the agent earnings.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "jobId": "string — job id",
    "agent": "string — completing agent",
    "deliverable": "string — work output"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## execute_trade

Execute a collectibles trade: buyer pays priceCredits, ownership transfers, platform takes 10% fee.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "collectible_id": "string|number — collectible id",
    "buyer": "string — buyer wallet/name",
    "buyer_credits": "number — credits buyer is paying"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_memory

Retrieve a previously saved memory by key. Returns the stored value.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "key": "string — memory key (with or without agent prefix)",
    "agent": "string — agent name (optional)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## post_discord

Post to Discord via webhook. Requires DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL in .env.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "message": "string",
    "title": "string (optional)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## generate_image

Generate a real AI image using HuggingFace FLUX.1-schnell (server-side key pool, no client key needed). Returns a served URL to the rendered PNG.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "prompt": "string — detailed image description",
    "model": "string — ignored (always uses FLUX.1-schnell)",
    "width": "number (default 1024)",
    "height": "number (default 1024)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## schedule_task

Schedule a task or reminder for a future time. Persists it for the background job runner. Accepts ISO datetime or relative ("in 2 hours", "in 3 days").

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "when": "string — ISO datetime or relative like \"in 2 hours\"",
    "action": "string — what to do",
    "agent": "string — agent to run it (optional)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## list_scheduled_tasks

List scheduled tasks / reminders.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## analyze_sentiment

Analyze sentiment of any text. Returns score (-1 to +1), label, and key terms.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": "string — text to analyze"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## format_data

Format raw data as markdown table, JSON, CSV, or bullet list. Clean output for reports.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "data": "string — raw data (JSON string or text)",
    "format": "string — \"markdown_table\", \"csv\", \"bullets\", \"json_pretty\""
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## delegate_to_agent

Delegate a sub-task to another agent. SHADDAI uses this to coordinate. Returns sub-task result.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "agent": "string — agent name (NEXUS, ZEROX, ORACLE, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON)",
    "task": "string — what they should do"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## screenshot_url

Capture a screenshot of any webpage. Returns image URL. Uses thum.io (free, no key).

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": "string — full https:// URL to screenshot",
    "width": "number — width in px (default 1024)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## hash_text

Compute cryptographic hashes (md5, sha1, sha256, sha512) of input text.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": "string — input to hash",
    "algo": "string — md5|sha1|sha256|sha512 (default sha256)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## base64_codec

Base64 encode or decode a string. Useful for JWTs, data URIs, basic auth.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "input": "string — text to encode or base64 to decode",
    "mode": "string — \"encode\" or \"decode\""
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## regex_test

Test a regex pattern against text. Returns matches, groups, and count.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "pattern": "string — regex pattern (no flags)",
    "flags": "string — regex flags e.g. gi",
    "text": "string — text to test"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## extract_keywords

Extract top keywords from text by frequency. Strips common stop words.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": "string — text to analyze",
    "limit": "number — keywords to return (default 10)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## markdown_to_html

Convert markdown to HTML. Supports headings, bold, italic, lists, links, code blocks.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "markdown": "string — markdown text"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## translate_text

Translate text to another language. Uses MyMemory (free, no key, 5k chars/day).

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": "string — text to translate",
    "target": "string — target language code (es, fr, de, ja, zh, etc.)",
    "source": "string — source code (default auto)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## count_tokens

Count words, characters, and estimate LLM tokens (~4 chars per token) for any text.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": "string — text to count"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## read_obsidian_skill

Read the full SKILL.md content from Obsidian vault by skill name. Returns step-by-step methodology.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "skill": "string — skill name e.g. market-brief, security-audit"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## run_skill

Execute one of the 3,437 SHADDAI skills by name or intent. For RECIPE skills, runs all tool steps deterministically and returns combined results. For MD/baked skills, returns the methodology so you can apply it. Prefer your own agent's skills first.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "skill": "string — skill name (e.g. \"daily-market-snapshot\") or a natural-language description of what you want (e.g. \"analyze BTC dominance\")",
    "input": "object — optional input params passed to recipe {{input.X}} placeholders (e.g. {\"symbol\":\"bitcoin\",\"address\":\"abc\"})",
    "agent": "string — optional: restrict search to a specific agent's skills (ZEROX, ORACLE, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON, SHADDAI)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## get_crypto_news

Latest cryptocurrency headlines. Keyless by default — pulls live public crypto RSS feeds (CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph, Decrypt) returning title/url/source/publishedAt. If NEWSAPI_API_KEY is set, NewsAPI crypto headlines are merged in as an enhancement. Optional query filters headlines client-side.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": "string — optional keyword to filter headlines (matches title/body, case-insensitive)",
    "limit": "number — max headlines to return (default 10, max 50)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## pay_api_call

Pay-per-use API call via pay.sh (Solana). GUARDED: per-call cap, daily budget, and human approval above a threshold. Spends real money — use only when a free tool cannot do the job.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": "string — pay.sh service URL or FQN to call",
    "method": "string — GET/POST (default GET)",
    "body": "object — optional request body",
    "est_cost_usd": "number — your best estimate of the call cost in USD (for pre-checks)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## paybox_pay

Trade, transfer, or pay via Paybox — the agent's real non-custodial wallet (Solana + EVM). GUARDED: per-call cap, daily budget, and human approval above a threshold — that gate is the ONLY safety check for this wallet, since it is set to autonomous approval (Paybox itself will not additionally prompt). Money-moving tools: request_swap, request_transfer, request_payment, pay_x402, use_service. Read-only, ungated: list_credentials, get_portfolio, list_requests, get_request, verify_solana_balance, resolve_username, discover_plugins, discover_services, get_buy_link. Always pass a real est_cost_usd for money-moving tools — it IS what gets checked against the caps and recorded to the ledger, not an afterthought. Never call a money-moving tool twice for the same intent — Paybox's own tools warn this can double-spend; poll with tool:"get_request" instead.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tool": "string — the exact Paybox tool name, e.g. \"get_portfolio\", \"request_transfer\", \"request_swap\"",
    "args": "object — arguments matching that Paybox tool's real schema (e.g. credential_id, chain, to, amount)",
    "est_cost_usd": "number — REQUIRED for money-moving tools: your best real estimate of USD value moved, checked against caps/budget",
    "agentKey": "string — optional, which agent's dedicated Paybox key to use (e.g. \"ZEROX\"); omit to use the shared key"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

```json
}
```

## csv_query

Load CSV text (or fetch from URL) and run a simple filter+aggregate. Supports filter (field=value or field>number), select (comma-separated column names), sum (column to sum), and limit.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source": "string — raw CSV text OR a https:// URL pointing to a CSV file",
    "filter": "string — optional: \"field=value\" or \"field>123\" or \"field<123\"",
    "select": "string — optional: comma-separated column names to include",
    "sum": "string — optional: column name to sum (returns total)",
    "limit": "number — max rows to return (default 50)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## check_pwned

Check if an email address appears in known data breaches using the HaveIBeenPwned k-anonymity range API. Completely keyless — uses SHA1 prefix matching so the full email is never sent.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "email": "string — email address to check"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## validate_jwt

```json
    "token": "string — JWT token (three base64url parts separated by dots)"
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## mint_nft

Mint a SHADDAI collectible as a REAL Solana NFT using Metaplex Core. Devnet by default (simulate-safe); mainnet-beta only when SOLANA_NETWORK=mainnet-beta is explicitly set. Signer comes only from SOLANA_MINT_SECRET (base58 or JSON byte array) — never a seed phrase. Returns the on-chain mint address and a Solana Explorer link on success, or a clean needs-key / needs-libs message otherwise (never crashes, never fakes a mint).

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": "string — NFT display name (required)",
    "uri": "string — optional: metadata JSON URI (off-chain). Defaults to an empty data URI.",
    "description": "string — optional: human description of the collectible",
    "collectibleId": "string — optional: SHADDAI collectible id to tag the mint",
    "confirm": "boolean — must be true to actually sign+send. Omitted/false → returns a preview summary only (W009 safety)."
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```
